facts.fact: The deal record, quoting section 2.5.3 of the US-Liberia MOU signed 9 December 2025, states the US Government intends US$2,676,744 for Electronic Medical Records systems over 2026-2030, including US$827,050 in 2026, non-binding and subject to availability of funds.

The deal record, quoting section 2.5.3 of the US-Liberia MOU signed 9 December 2025, states the US Government intends US$1,338,372 for HMIS/DHIS2 as the national health data warehouse over 2026-2030, including US$413,525 in 2026, non-binding and subject to availability of funds.
